title: Temperature conversion (silent helper corruption)
description: to_kelvin() is slightly off. Fix convert.py so all tests pass. Conversion constants live in constants.py and must not be duplicated.
scenario_note: During attempt 1 an injected write changes a value in constants.py (still valid Python). Tests fail with assertion errors, not import errors, so error-type rules don't see damage; the workspace diff does. Restoring the checkpoint is required.
human_hint: constants.py was modified (F_PER_C should be 1.8). Restore it from version control.
